# region imports
from AlgorithmImports import *
# endregion

class EquityChandelierExitAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):

    def initialize(self) -> None:
        self.set_start_date(2022, 1, 1)
        self.set_end_date(2024, 12, 31)
        self.set_cash(100000)
        # automatic_indicator_warm_up only supports automatic indicators, not manual indicators.
        self.settings.automatic_indicator_warm_up = True
        self._equity = self.add_equity("SPY", Resolution.MINUTE)
        self._atr = self.atr(self._equity.symbol, 14, Resolution.DAILY)
        # Alternatively, use a manual indicator.
        # self._atr = AverageTrueRange(14)
        # self.warm_up_indicator(self._equity, self._atr, Resolution.DAILY)
        # self.register_indicator(self._equity, self._atr, Resolution.DAILY)
        self.plot_indicator("ATR", self._atr)
        self._atr_threshold = 3.0
        self._long_stop_loss = False
        self._stop_price = 0
        self.schedule.on(
            self.date_rules.every_day(self._equity.symbol),
            self.time_rules.after_market_open(self._equity.symbol, 30),
            self._rebalance
        )

    def _rebalance(self) -> None:
        if not self._atr.is_ready:
            return
        price = self._equity.price
        if not self._long_stop_loss:
            if price > self._stop_price:
                self.set_holdings(self._equity, 1)
                self._long_stop_loss = True
        else:
            if price < self._stop_price:
                self.liquidate(self._equity)
                self._long_stop_loss = False
            elif not self.portfolio.invested:
                self.set_holdings(self._equity, 1)
                self._long_stop_loss = True

    def on_order_event(self, order_event: OrderEvent) -> None:
        if order_event.status == OrderStatus.FILLED:
            self.plot("Fills", "SPY", order_event.fill_price * order_event.fill_quantity)

    def on_data(self, data: Slice) -> None:
        bar = data.bars.get(self._equity)
        if not bar:
            return
        atr_value = self._atr.current.value
        if not self._atr.is_ready:
            self.plot("ATR", "Value", atr_value)
            return
        stop_loss_price = bar.close - (self._atr_threshold * atr_value)
        self.plot("ATR", "Stop Loss", stop_loss_price)
        if abs(self._stop_price - stop_loss_price) > 0.0001:
            self._stop_price = stop_loss_price

    def on_warmup_finished(self) -> None:
        self._rebalance()
